sample.question:
This is a Sokoban puzzle where cartoon person is player, green X is target, brown box with X is box to push, brown tiles are walls, and light brown areas are movable spaces.The coordinates (x, y) in this puzzle represent the matrix format.If the player makes these moves: Left → Left → Up → Right → Right, where will player end up?

Options:
[1] (2, 2)
[2] (2, 3)
[3] (2, 1)
[4] (3, 2)
[5] (3, 3)
[6] (1, 2)
[7] (3, 1)
[8] (1, 3)
sample.analysis:
- Player position: (3, 3)
- Boxes positions: (2, 2)
- Target positions: (2, 1)
Move sequence analysis:
Initial position: (3, 3)
Move 1 - Left: Player moves from (3, 3) to (3, 2)
Move 2 - Left: Player moves from (3, 2) to (3, 1)
Move 3 - Up: Player moves from (3, 1) to (2, 1)
Move 4 - Right: Player moves from (2, 1) to (2, 2)
Move 5 - Right: Failed - Cannot push box (Player stays at (2, 2))

Final position: (2, 2)

So the answer is (2, 2). The option number is 1.
